text.text: What types of cookies do we use?
Mandatory cookies cannot be turned off as they are required for the good functioning of the website. However, these cookies do not track you.
Performance and Analytics cookies are used by third-party service providers such as Google Analytics for statistics that further help us improve your experience on our website.
Tracking cookies are used by social media ads accounts (e.g. through Facebook Pixel) to target ads according to your preferences, demographics and pattern of digital actions.
Although the data collected by tracking cookies helps us to target ads better, the data in cause remains anonymous to us.
